reviews.text: Don’t learn this the hard way. Protect your pet & stay away from here.
There’s a reason why there are no cameras in the grooming room & it’s underground. Unprofessional is secondary - the real problem is the treatment and safety of your dog.

I took my dog to Verve for grooming and was shocked to be charged £185, an unexpectedly high and uncommunicated price that I never anticipated paying. I trusted that such a premium fee would at least guarantee the highest standards of care.

Instead, when we got home, I found blood across my carpets and stairs. My dog’s paw had clearly been cut during the grooming, leaving him in pain and distress. I immediately contacted Verve with photos and a clear explanation of what had happened, but I’ve received no response or apology.

They suggested I bring my dog back into the salon, but with an open wound on his paw, that simply wasn’t an option I was willing to risk.

I have also just found out that this venue has given my dog fleas.

This entire experience has been deeply upsetting. At a minimum, I expected professionalism and a duty of care, neither of which were delivered. I’m now seeking a full refund and will escalate this further if necessary. I hope this review encourages Verve to take accountability and treat both pets and customers with the respect they deserve.
I wouldn’t trust Andre, the owner with my animals.
Horrible place stay away

I couldn’t be happier with the experience. My dog can be quite anxious, but Andrea handled her with so much patience and care—it really put me at ease. He clearly understand how to work with nervous dogs, and it showed throughout the whole appointment.
The products used were fantastic—my dog absolutely loved it. She smelled amazing for over a week, which is impressive since she usually tries to roll in other smells straight away. This time, she didn’t feel the need at all! Her fur was also incredibly soft and smooth afterward.
On top of that, Andrea recommended a harness to help with her pulling, and it’s been a game changer. It fits perfectly and has made walks so much more manageable.
Highly recommend—great service, great care, and really thoughtful advice.
Great
Had a lovely time here yesterday-delicious hot drinks and adorable canine company ♥️ the staff are also so welcoming :) will definitely return!

Stumbled across this place on a visit from Miami - ended up staying and hanging out with Andre and the dogs for a couple of hours! He has lots of great stories. The collars are very high quality, sturdy leather and more options and designs than you can imagine! Ended up buying two but wish I got more. My dog looks like a model ❤️

THANK YOU!!!! My teacup Yorkie rolled in mess in the park and I needed an emergency wash immediately. Andre was amazing! He dropped everything and said ‘bring her over, I’ll fit her in’! He even trimmed her coat, nails and cleaned her ears! More or less a full Groom when I just needed a wash and blow dry. Super grateful, professional and my Yorkie was happy!
Andre the cafe owner is super friendly and very genuine. And there is a huge collection of cool clothes in the neck of the cafe that he designs and makes.... A hidden gem!

Andre is simply the best. As a young, busy media professional, finding the right trainer and support for my dog was essential. My Vietnamese Ridgeback puppy had been attending regular training sessions at the Verve shop, along with one-to-one walks, and under Andre’s guidance he has improved tremendously. (It’s barely been 2 weeks!)

This is an exceptionally intelligent and challenging breed that constantly tests boundaries. Especially in the teenage phase… He is stubborn and wary, and Ridgebacks take time to trust others and let people in.  Their intelligence means they don’t comply blindly, they assess, question, and push limits - which makes proper training absolutely essential but also very challenging at this stage.

In just two weeks, Andre has established real discipline, taught him tricks, and created a calm, positive, and structured environment where my puppy can thrive and grow. This is one of the smartest and rarest breeds in the world, and the start was far from easy. I have been considering re-homing the boy!

Moving home around London and travelling with a puppy still in development increased his reactivity and snappiness, and stress. With Andre’s help, we’ve been able to calm his nervous system so he can learn, engage, and enjoy the process rather than react to it and build daily discipline.

Being able to pop him in and out of Andre’s store has given me real peace of mind and hope, knowing my puppy is getting the most out of his days, learning and being stimulated, even when I’m stuck on back-to-back calls and meetings and can’t be there or running late.

The shop is the perfect real-life training environment. Think about it. While you might think it’s better for dogs to simply run around, the exposure to real situations is invaluable: waiting, patience, customers walking in and out, approaching unfamiliar people, sitting calmly and not reaching and reacting and learning alongside Andre’s extremely well-trained dogs. Not to mention the top-tier snacks always on tap.

Oh and the HARNESS - My Ridgeback is very active, and I run with him often. After trying multiple harnesses, I couldn’t find one that truly worked -  even the “Halti” rubbed him and caused hair loss. Andre’s custom cotton harness design is genuinely the best in the GAME: chic, functional, and incredibly durable. This dog has chewed through every leash I’ve owned, yet he hasn’t been able to damage any of these.

We love Andre. He trains dogs with a balance of love, structure, and firmness - exactly what intelligent, boundary-testing breeds need. It’s very hard to find individuals who understand animals to the depth they deserve to be. Everything he works on in the store, I continue at home, and the results after just two weeks are undeniable. I couldn’t recommend him more. I truly believe my dog is becoming a well-behaved, regal, and elegant boy.
It smells like dog urine, the floor is dirty.

The most unprofessional pet shop ever!
I am so deeply disappointed with the service!
Would give 0 stars if I could!
Avoid avoid avoid!!

First of all the owner is so vague and shady about the prices of the items in his shop; there are no price tags on anything, and I only found out how extortionate the items were after he had customised them, which pressured me into buying at huge expense. Every time we asked about the prices, he evaded the question saying “it’s not expensive”, which was a lie.
I reluctantly paid the high price thinking they would be quality items but only a few weeks later the collar has faded terribly!!
I also ordered a name tag, which has not turned up. I have tried repeatedly to call the owner, to no avail.

If I don’t hear back soon, or receive my expensive name tag, I will be calling trading standards to complain, especially after reading the other terrible reviews on google!!

“Andre” or whatever his name is needs to be shut down, reported to RSPCA and never work with animals again. I have never been so disappointed with a service before! If you care about your money or your pets never go to this shop!!

Dreadful, my dog was shaved and is now on prednisolone to alleviate his itching, his body hair was cut too short and his head and tail and ears were not groomed at all.  I was quoted £80 to do his grooming but charged £110 for an unfinished dreadful groom. Stay clear.
Great Service. Great dog Shampoo.
Amazing cafe, such cool doggies and lovely people who run the place!

Would not recommend taking your dogs here for grooming. The owner clearly abuses dogs. I witnessed him beating his dog today, with dog rushing to hide under chairs. He also can’t manage his emotions and very aggressive - when we politely asked and noted that it’s not nice to hit dogs, he cussed us out of there, while threatening us if we don’t leave.
I bring my miniature long-haired dachshund here for her grooms, and she always comes out looking beautiful! Highly recommend.
Excellent service including dog sitting, grooming, disciplinary and exercising.  Can't stress how good André is with dogs.

“’m extremely particular about where I take my four little fur babies. They’ve grown into the most beautiful adult doggies, and I only want the best for them. Verve Pet Boutique is genuinely the only place I trust. Their grooming is top-notch—my pups come back looking absolutely fabulous—and on top of that, they get to wear these custom handmade collars and leads that add such a unique touch. I couldn’t be happier with the care they provide.

Beautiful place!
Andres was absolutely amazing — so welcoming and a fantastic carer for the dogs!
The dogs were not only adorable but also very well trained, making the experience even more enjoyable.
The store itself was beautiful, spotless, and had such a warm, inviting atmosphere.
It was truly the best experience I’ve had in London so far, and I can’t recommend it enough for any dog lover!
PS amazing boutique

Very nice and hygienic place. Met with Andres the owner who was extremely caring and loving of all the dogs. By far one of the greatest experiences to witness in London and will definitely come back very soon. Recommend to everyone.

My German sheperd Bruno hates his nails cut! he despises it! I cannot even touch his paws, brought him to Andre and he clipped them all in 5 minutes! he is a magician!!! I would recommend him no doubt!
I came to buy treats, left with a new collar and lead, and a glass of wine! lovely relaxing place and good chat!
Cane today for the first time as I was reccomended by a friend, and it exceeded my expectations, groom was fabolous! for my toy poodle Henry. will be back soon! thank you x
lovely place! amazing groom for my pomeranian, had videos and pictures of the process, very informative owner! also offered a glass of champagne while waiting! 10/10

I would rate zero stars if I could…

We took our two Maine Coon cats for grooming here yesterday. The appointment was originally quoted as taking around 2 hours, but ended up lasting 6 hours. One grooming was acceptable, but the other cat was shaved almost completely from the lower back down, with no blending, leaving an uneven and unfinished appearance. We raised this politely, asking only for a refund for that one cat.

The response was deeply disappointing. Instead of addressing our points, the groomer phoned and suggested that we were the problem, explaining that the cat’s behaviour (hissing and biting) limited what could be done. The conversation quickly became unprofessional, with the emphasis on how difficult the job was rather than any acknowledgment of any of our concerns. We were also told that no refund would be provided because the groomer felt the work was in his opinion excellent and appropriately finished given the circumstances.

We understand that cat grooming can be challenging, but we expected more from a professional pet groomer who has been in business for 15 years. At the very least, an honest discussion and notification of the results before handing the cats back to us in carriers would have been appropriate.

We have owned Maine Coons for many years and have never experienced anything like this with previous Maine coon cats we have had with other groomers. Sadly, this experience has left us unwilling to return. We would not recommend this groomer’s services for anyone’s animals, especially cats, unless the end result you were after was the feline equivalent of a badly mowed lawn, at a cost of £120.
